summary.goal: Optimize the agent task prompts built by buildTaskPrompt() and buildForgeMcpInstructions() in forge-spawner.ts. Current prompts are functional but basic — they list task details and MCP curl examples. Need model-specific strategies, better context injection, structured acceptance criteria formatting, and workspace-aware instructions.

acceptance_criteria.description: Model-specific prompt variants exist for at least claude and codex CLIs (different instruction styles, context window awareness)
Acceptance criteria are formatted as a structured checklist the agent can self-verify against before calling report_complete
Workspace context is injected: relevant file paths, repo structure hints, language/framework detection from scope config
Prompt includes dependency context: what predecessor tasks produced (artifacts from completed dependencies)
Prompt template is configurable via ForgeConfig (not hardcoded in forge-spawner.ts)
MCP tool instructions include error handling guidance (what to do if curl fails, how to retry)
Prompts are tested: at least 3 scenarios verified to produce correct agent behavior (trivial task, multi-file task, task with dependencies)

observations: Current prompt built in server/src/relay/forge-spawner.ts by buildTaskPrompt() and buildForgeMcpInstructions()
Prompt includes: task ID, run ID, step title, description, scope, role, acceptance criteria, MCP curl examples
No model-specific adaptation — same prompt for claude, codex, gemini
No workspace context — agent doesn't know what files exist, what language/framework is used
No dependency context — agent doesn't know what predecessor tasks produced
ForgeConfig has role_cli_mapping and repo configs but these aren't used in prompt construction
Relay client's buildMcpContext() generates planner MCP instructions separately — forge MCP is independent
patterns: Prompt template pattern from ForgeConfig (similar to how role_cli_mapping works)
Artifact query from storage for dependency context
Scope → repo config lookup for workspace context

architect.target_location: Template in ForgeConfig, rendering in forge-spawner.ts
architect.model_variants: At minimum: claude (structured, verbose), codex (concise, code-focused)
architect.workspace_context_source: ForgeConfig repo configs + file system scan at spawn time
